rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. From the tool calls, the agent directly executed order-changing writes—canceling two pending orders and initiating returns on delivered orders—without first confirming each action with the user. The agent also selected a refund method (gift card) without obtaining the user’s preference. There’s no clear authentication beyond finding a user by one of the two emails provided; the agent did not address the second email/account that the user also owns, potentially missing additional orders. Finally, the closing message provides no final, accurate summary of actions taken or their results. These issues violate the requirements to authenticate, confirm before writes, act only on the correct account(s), and provide correct final information. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass bar.
